newsitem.title: INDIA: At least 32 feared dead in India bus crash.
newsitem.headline: At least 32 feared dead in India bus crash.

text.p: At least 32 people are feared dead when their bus plunged into a river near the industrial city of Ahmedabad in India's western state of Gujarat on Thursday, local newsagencies said.
The bus, carrying more than 50 people, was travelling to the textile city of Surat from Una in the desert district of Saurashtra, the Press Trust of India (PTI) reported.
It said 20 people managed to swim to safety, and quoted local officials as saying that 15 bodies had been recovered.

"The bus skidded off the road and plunged into the river and turned turtle," the United News of India (UNI) reported. Fire brigade divers and police used a crane to pull the bus out of the water, it added.
Officials were still looking for 17 other passengers, UNI said. There have been heavy rains in Gujarat in the past week with many rivers overflowing its banks, officials said.
